t: The authority of the Secretary to provide assistance under this subtitle terminates on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

fable.w: This is a sunset provision that ends the Secretary's authority to provide assistance after 15 years. The word "assistance" might hint at a program involving outside recipients, but receiving assistance is not participating in a federal decision. The section sets up no consultation, comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government.
fable.s: The authority of the Secretary to provide assistance under this subtitle terminates on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

qwen_block.s: The authority of the Secretary to provide assistance under this subtitle terminates on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.

opus.w: This is a sunset clause that ends the Secretary's authority to provide assistance after 15 years. It sets up no process for outside parties to take part in a federal decision: no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory committee or right to sue. Mentioning "assistance" does not count, because receiving or applying for benefits or grants is excluded from the definition of participation.
opus.s: The authority of the Secretary to provide assistance under this subtitle terminates on the date that is 15 years after the date of enactment of this Act.
